baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired plural imperatives in `kulu wa-shrabu`, the adverbial `hani'an`, and the retrospective causal phrase `bi-ma kuntum ta'malun`.
baseline_models.mechanism: Literal eating and drinking deliver bodily benefit; `hani'an` removes hardship and harmful aftereffect from that benefit, while the retrospective clause connects it to an established pattern of intentional action.

activation_trace.role: Literal food ingestion anchors the first imperative as bodily reception rather than metaphor alone.
Literal imbibing anchors the second imperative and completes the material satisfaction of the meal.
Easy wholesome benefit without hardship or bad aftereffect governs the manner and result of both commands.
Temporal predication places the deeds in an established former course of life.
Intentional doing makes purposive conduct, rather than accidental motion, the stated basis of the benefit.

changed_reading.before: Eat and drink as a simple permission to enjoy refreshments.
changed_reading.after: Receive an embodied enjoyment free of painful aftermath, in consequence of the deliberate course of action you formerly sustained.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The consumption roots and the causal attachment of `bi-ma kuntum ta'malun` to the plural commands.
baseline_models.mechanism: Food and water can each be conceptualized as an allotted share, `hani'` can name giving and maintenance, and `amal` can name a worker's pay; together these branches make the banquet resemble provision allocated against work.

activation_trace.role: A consumable share or provision turns the food into an allotment received by the addressees.
An allotted share of water gives the drink the same distributive structure as the food.
Giving and maintenance recast pleasant consumption as provision that adequately supports its recipients.
The wage or provision of a worker supplies the compensation link between prior work and present allotment.

changed_reading.before: The food and drink are an undifferentiated gift.
changed_reading.after: The food and drink can be heard as an allotted maintenance-share issued in relation to the recipients' work.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal contrast between `kuntum ta'malun` and the present commands, focused by `hani'an`.
baseline_models.mechanism: A former period of self-exertion is converted into present benefit that requires no struggle and produces no bad consequence; the verse therefore stages a reversal from labor to ease, not merely a payment event.

activation_trace.role: Temporal being separates the former condition of acting from the now-imperative condition of receiving.
Self-exertion and taking trouble supply the effortful input to the temporal reversal.
Benefit without hardship or bad aftereffect supplies the effortless output of that reversal.

changed_reading.before: Past deeds merely explain why a reward is available.
changed_reading.after: The command marks a temporal conversion: former exertion has become present, consequence-free ease.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural morphology of both imperatives and the coordinated acts of eating and drinking.
baseline_models.mechanism: The supplied consumption branches include co-eating and a group of co-drinkers, while `hani'` can carry congratulatory blessing; the plural command can therefore constitute a shared table and public acclamation rather than parallel private appetites.

activation_trace.role: Food ingestion, whose supplied scope includes eating with another, anchors a shared rather than solitary meal.
A group of drinkers and watering companions makes the second plural command socially coordinated.
Congratulatory blessing lets `hani'an` function as an acclamation over the gathered recipients.

changed_reading.before: Each addressee privately satisfies hunger and thirst.
changed_reading.after: The plural command convenes a shared table whose fellowship itself publicly marks blessed success.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protective disposition leads into shelter, flowing sources, and desired fruit; those environmental affordances terminate in eating and drinking, while `hani'an` names the system-level absence of harm or adverse residue.

activation_trace.role: Putting oneself within protection identifies the recipients by a harm-avoiding disposition that opens the scene.
Literal shade as cover supplies the sheltering layer of the habitat.
A source of running water supplies the drink at its environmental origin.
Pleasant fruit supplies the edible yield immediately before the command to eat.
The soul's inclination toward what it desires makes provision responsive to the recipients rather than generic.
Literal ingestion converts the supplied fruit into embodied benefit.
Literal drinking converts the running sources into embodied benefit.
Wholesome benefit without hardship or bad aftereffect states the successful condition of the whole provisioning system.

structural_cues: 77:41-43 runs from the recipients' protected location, through coordinated water and fruit objects, into direct plural imperatives.
The desired fruit of 77:42 is the nearest explicit edible antecedent to `kulu`, and the springs of 77:41 are the nearest drink-source to `wa-shrabu`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, shade, springs, fruit, desire, and then consumption; I supply the arrow that treats them as one functioning provision chain. A live alternative is that they are a paratactic list of rewards without causal system structure.

changed_reading.before: The verse grants an isolated pleasant meal.
changed_reading.after: The verse is the terminal operation of a protected, desire-responsive ecology in which shelter, source, yield, and appetite meet without harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: A universal gathering is subjected to discriminating judgment; a protected cohort is then addressed with the meal and identified afterward as recipients of corresponding recompense for good action. The hospitality thus enacts a public verdict and status allocation.

activation_trace.role: Judgment that distinguishes truth from falsehood supplies the adjudicating operation before the meal scene.
Gathering what was dispersed supplies the public population on which distinction operates.
Self-placement within protection identifies the cohort emerging on the favorable side of the distinction.
Consumable provision makes the favorable verdict concrete as an allocated share.
Intentional action supplies the conduct on which the favorable identification rests.
Answering an act with its recompense explicitly classifies the hospitality as a corresponding outcome.
Doing what is good specifies the favorable quality of the prior intentional action.

structural_cues: 77:38 announces the day of distinction and gathering before 77:41 identifies the protected cohort.
The command in 77:43 is followed immediately by the generalizing recompense statement in 77:44.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, judgment, a protected cohort, direct hospitality, and recompense; I infer that the meal performs the favorable verdict in public. The sequence could instead juxtapose separate scenes without implying a formal admission rite.

changed_reading.before: The addressees receive a private reward meal.
changed_reading.after: Their admission to the meal publicly materializes an adjudicated identity and allotted standing after the universal gathering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from generative water in a condition of weakness, through a measured developmental limit, to water actively supplied as sweet; the final command to drink `hani'an` becomes the pleasurable endpoint of a water-mediated arc of formation and maintenance.

activation_trace.role: Generative fluid in the womb supplies water as the material point of human origin.
Lowliness and weakness qualify that origin as vulnerable rather than self-sufficient.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit supplies bounded development between origin and later reception.
Giving drink turns water from origin-material into an intentionally delivered provision.
Ordinary water supplies the material continuity between earlier formation and later drinking.
Sweet fresh water supplies the transformed, desirable quality of the delivered provision.
Literal drinking brings the water sequence inside the recipient as its final embodied uptake.
Wholesome benefit without bad aftereffect marks the final draught as the completed positive form of the sequence.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 presents origin, secure development, and known measure; 77:27 returns to supplied sweet water; 77:43 issues the command to drink.
The same `m w h` cue occurs at both 77:20 and 77:27, allowing a material recurrence rather than merely a broad water theme.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated water, vulnerable origin, measure, supplied sweetness, and final drinking; I infer a continuous transformation arc. The two water scenes can alternatively be independent signs, not stages of one material biography.

changed_reading.before: Drink a pleasant beverage placed before you.
changed_reading.after: Drink the wholesome endpoint of a water-mediated passage from vulnerable origin, through measured formation, to deliberately supplied sweetness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact eating imperative recurs for a condemned cohort, so eating itself cannot carry the favorable value. In 77:43 it expands into drinking, wholesomeness, and retrospective action; in 77:46 it contracts into a little enjoyment under criminal identity. Duration, consequence, and status determine the two horizons.

activation_trace.role: Literal eating supplies the repeated lexical control shared by the two commands.
Wholesomeness without adverse consequence supplies the favorable command's distinctive horizon.
Intentional action supplies the retrospective moral basis absent from the later eating command.
The same literal ingestion repeats the imperative while stripping it of inherently favorable force.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the real but morally unstable pleasure paired with the second eating command.
Littleness constrains that pleasure in amount or duration and creates the sharp horizon contrast.
Offense and guilt identify the later consumers by a status opposed to the favorable addressees.

structural_cues: 77:43 and 77:46 both open with the identical plural imperative `kulu`.
The favorable command adds drinking, `hani'an`, and a past-action clause; the later command adds enjoyment, `qalilan`, and the assertion `innakum mujrimun`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the controlled lexical repetition and opposed qualifiers; I infer that 77:43's lack of limitation and its no-bad-aftereffect branch imply a durable horizon. The 77:46 command may be ironic threat rather than genuine permission, but either pragmatics preserves the contrast.

changed_reading.before: Eating is itself the sign of blessed reward.
changed_reading.after: The focus command marks vindicated, wholesome consumption precisely because the same act elsewhere is short-lived and condemning; moral horizon, not appetite, distinguishes it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah classifies the preceding scene as action answered by recompense and names its recipients as doers of good. This preserves the focus verse's work-result relation while revising the baseline's commercial wage image into exemplary correspondence for `ihsan`.

activation_trace.role: A worker's wage supplies the baseline compensation image that context will qualify.
Wholesome benefit supplies the concrete favorable outcome being classified.
Matching an act with its recompense explicitly names correspondence rather than an ordinary labor contract.
Doing a good act specifies the qualitative content of the focus verse's otherwise open `what you used to do`.

structural_cues: 77:44 immediately follows the command and begins `inna kadhalika`, pointing back to a demonstrated mode of treatment.
The open relative `ma` in 77:43 is followed by the explicit agent label `al-muhsinin` in 77:44.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency, deictic `kadhalika`, recompense, and `muhsinin`; I infer that the demonstrative includes the meal scene and that `ihsan` specifies its deed-class. It could point to the entire 77:41-43 reward cluster rather than the meal alone.

changed_reading.before: The banquet is pay mechanically exchanged for work.
changed_reading.after: The banquet exemplifies a fitting response to `ihsan`: correspondence remains, but the relation is recompense rather than a commercial wage bargain.

context_deltas.mechanism: One cohort cannot speak and receives no authorization even to excuse itself; the focus cohort is directly addressed with two positive imperatives that authorize bodily action. The meal command thus marks admitted agency and addressability as well as nourishment.

activation_trace.role: Speech and articulation, explicitly negated in its source, supply the disabled agency of the contrasted cohort.
Permission or authorization, also negated in its source, supplies the withheld access that the later commands reverse.
The positive imperative to ingest food grants actionable participation to the addressed cohort.
The coordinated imperative to drink doubles the enacted authorization rather than merely reporting available goods.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 uses repeated negative predication for speech and permission; 77:43 uses two direct positive imperatives.
The condemned are discussed in the third person, whereas the rewarded are addressed in the second-person plural.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied speech and permission followed by direct positive address; I infer that being commandable here signals admitted agency and access. The scenes may contrast only outcomes, without making addressability an independent reward.

changed_reading.before: The imperatives simply tell recipients how to use available food and drink.
changed_reading.after: The imperatives enact restored agency and authorized access for people admitted to act, in contrast with those denied even an authorized response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punitive sequence offers a shade that does not protect from flame and flying sparks; the favorable sequence supplies genuine protection and shade before the command to eat. Activated by the focus root's branch of fire consuming fuel, the contrast reverses agency: these addressees consume harmless provision rather than stand exposed to consuming fire.

activation_trace.role: Shade as literal cover is negated at the punitive destination, defining shelter that fails to shelter.
The tongue and blaze of fire supplies the consuming hazard against which shade is tested.
Flying fire-sparks make the hazard materially active rather than a merely abstract evil.
Ward­ing off harm supplies the successful protective counter-operation before the favorable shade and meal.
Fire consuming fuel is the branch-level hinge that lets eating reverse the direction of destructive consumption.
Literal food ingestion restores the focus command's primary direction: protected recipients consume provision.
Benefit without harmful aftereffect sharply opposes the destructive aftermath of exposure to flame.

structural_cues: 77:30-32 moves from commanded departure to failed shade, flame, and sparks; 77:41-43 moves from protected shade to eating and drinking.
The two scenes share shade vocabulary but give it opposite protective efficacy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed shade, flame, sparks, protection, real shade, and a focus eating branch for fire consuming fuel; I supply the reversal between consuming and being consumed. The text does not explicitly call the punished people fuel, so this remains a contained mechanism rather than a lexical claim.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are simply the agents who consume a meal.
changed_reading.after: Their harmless eating marks an agency reversal: they occupy the protected consuming side of the surah's material economy, not the side exposed to consuming flame.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because `kulu` is morphologically an eating imperative while totality comes from the packet's non-dominant `k l l` mapping. It remains packet-anchored through that explicitly supplied split target and is sharpened by the complete-gathering branch at 77:38. Downstream prose should render it only as a resonance of whole, unfragmented availability, never translate `kulu` as `all` or displace literal eating.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's split inventory for the focus root `ء ك ل`, specifically the non-dominant totality branch attached to focus word 1.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness overlay literal eating with a resonance of receiving the provision as an undivided whole.
Completion without dispersion or deficiency gives the whole-gathering resonance a visible context counterpart.
Benefit without bad residue lets completeness concern the reward's unspoiled uptake rather than quantity alone.

changed_reading.before: Take particular items of food and drink.
changed_reading.after: At a secondary resonance level, take the gathered reward wholly and without fragment, deficiency, or harmful remainder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because branches of drinking-as-understanding and heart-permeation are distant from the imperative's literal morphology. It remains anchored in the focus drinking root and gains context traction from the closing contrast between renewed discourse and heart-settling assent. Render it as an embodied-understanding undertone alongside literal food and drink, not as an esoteric replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb `wa-shrabu`, with supplied branches for understanding and for something permeating the heart.

activation_trace.role: Drinking as understanding turns bodily intake into a possible undertone of fully grasping the granted outcome.
Permeation into the heart supplies the inward path by which that grasp becomes settled rather than merely heard.
Speech renewed as news supplies the discourse that the surah's closing question says remains unreceived.
Assent that settles the heart supplies the reception mode opposed to the closing failure to believe.

changed_reading.after: As a contained undertone, drinking figures the granted reality becoming inwardly grasped and heart-settling, the opposite of hearing discourse without assent.

strongest_changes: The immediate 77:41-42 cluster changes the verse from standalone permission into the terminal act of a protected, desire-responsive provisioning ecology.
The explicit recompense and `ihsan` of 77:44 revise a branch-induced wage model into fitting correspondence for good action.
The repeated `kulu` in 77:46 makes consequence, duration, and moral identity, rather than eating itself, decisive for the focus command's value.
The recurring water sequence changes drinking into the final uptake of an arc from vulnerable origin through measured formation to supplied sweetness.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus command operate simultaneously as nourishment, allocation, verdict, temporal reversal, and contrastive speech act; exact repetition and recurrent material processes produced more change than broad thematic similarity.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether `hani'an` here marks only manner of consumption or also licenses the stronger durable no-aftermath horizon.
How far the causal `bi-ma` supports compensation language before 77:44 revises it away from a commercial wage model.
Whether public verdict and restored addressability are intended mechanisms or effects of sequential juxtaposition.
The fire-consumption, totality, and internalized-assurance readings are packet-anchored but branch-distant and should remain explicitly qualified.
